newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems wins 2 NASA contracts.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems wins 2 NASA contracts.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc said its Sun Microsystems Federal Inc subsidiary was awarded two NASA contracts with a value expected to exceed $100 million.

The contracts cover software development and electronic circuit design work at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center, and were awarded under the second phase of the federal government's Scientific and Engineering Workstation Procurement (SEWP II) program.
Sun Microsystems said its contract represents about 40 percent of the estimated 34,000 workstations projected to be procured under the life of SEWP II.
It said the contract will cover a four year period.
